title: blob-server: Blob/set handler
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B8. Crates: jmap-blob-server. Size: M.

Implement handle_blob_set in set.rs per docs/design/blobext.md §5 'Blob/set' (blobext-03 §3, §4, §7; RFC 8620 §5.3): non-null ifInState -> invalidArguments, oldState/newState null; create steps 1-9 factored as set::create_one (Blob/upload reuses it in B11): unknown property, maxDataSources tooLarge, topo_order with cycle -> invalidProperties [data] (gap d), unresolved #ref -> notFound (gap e), per-source validation -> invalidProperties [data] (gap f), maxSizeBlobSet tooLarge, whole size/digest mismatch -> invalidProperties [size]/[digest:<alg>] with no blob created, create_blob, expires always written, omit_from_response; update = touch expires only (other keys only at current value); destroy with blobHasReference; #refs in update keys and destroy ids. Common start incl. BlobMode Conflict -> invalidArguments. No conditional code here (decision 1). Acceptance: tests/set.rs covering every case in blobext.md §10 'server, Blob/set', with -03 §9.1 verbatim.
